name: Quirk
summary:
Quirk is a puzzle collection for iOS and Android with more than 120 puzzle types, grouped into 14 categories that cover logic, number, word and memory puzzles. Alongside well-known types such as Nonogram, Kakuro, Star Battle, Tents, Bridges, Light Up and Binairo, it includes push and sorting puzzles like Sokoban and Tube Sort, and a Daily Quirk mode that offers a new puzzle every day on a calendar.

Every level is designed to be solved by deduction, without guessing. Each puzzle type opens with a short introduction, and the hint system first highlights where to look before explaining the next step. There are no timers, the game works offline and it does not require an account. It is free to play with ads between puzzles; a one-time purchase removes them.
